newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board in line with higher prices in Japan after some moderate late buying interest, brokers said on Monday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were boosted by the yen's weakness against the U.S. dollar and firmer overseas markets, which have been lifted by heavy rainfall disrupting tapping.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due to an absence of fresh incentives. But prices were marked up in the afternoon on some late buying interest in sympathy with higher prices in Japan. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, November RSS3 rose 1.25 cents to 132.00 U.S. cents a kg.
October RSS1 rose 1.50 cents to 190.50 Singapore cents (US$1.36) a kg.
January/March TSR20 rose three cents to 187.50 Singapore cents (US$1.33) a kg.
